end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Om named standing, sleeping and slanting examples from pictures and objects.
Om initially mixed up “straight” with direction; Asha revisited that all three lines are straight.
After the break, Om explained that slanting lines are straight but tilted and do not bend.
Teach-back was not fully passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting lines using goalposts, pitch lines, the letter A and a slide. They used the method of checking whether a line bends, then describing its direction; the mix-up about slanting lines being straight was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Om to find one example of each line type and say whether it bends and which direction it goes.
